claims.claim: A consumption-plan instance starting from cold often takes several seconds before any code runs
claims.about: .NET Azure Functions on the consumption plan
claims.why: The only related figure is csharp-aspnet's 785 ms container start-up. That measures ASP.NET Core in Docker, not an Azure Functions worker, and it leaves out the time Azure takes to allocate an instance on the consumption plan.

claims.claim: Switching language wouldn't solve the deadline anyway, because Node also has cold starts on the consumption plan
claims.about: Node.js (and by implication Go) on Azure Functions consumption plan
claims.why: Container start-up times of 593–706 ms for Node and 238–293 ms for Go were measured, but nothing on Azure Functions consumption-plan cold starts, so the claim can't be checked.
